look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST — LINDHEIMER'S DOVEWEED / WOOLLY CROTON: a robust MONOECIOUS annual with young yellow-brown (ochraceous) woolly hairs, predominantly ACUTE leaf tips and some rounded or heart-shaped leaf bases. The key distinction from true C. capitatus is in FEMALE flowers: 7–8 long woolly sepals (about 5–7 mm) with tips STRAIGHT or only slightly INCURVED, NOT flaring strongly outward after flowering. Three styles branch twice, often 12 terminal branches. The source-licensed existing habit and flowering photos cannot confirm actual mature sepal posture; keep this image gap. Do not confuse C. lindheimeri with C. lindheimerianus, the much smaller low annual with short female sepals and only SIX style ends.
